subject: Request for bridge letter and interim evidence for SOC 2 Type II coverage
messages:
From: Eva Guzman <eva.guzman@heliotech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: security@heliotech.com
Date: 2027-04-07T16:12:00Z
Subject: Bridge letter / interim evidence request for SOC 2 coverage

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're moving toward vendor approval for our HelioTech Platform product and a couple of items came up during our procurement review. Our security team needs: 1) a short bridge letter confirming Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report period and any material control changes since the report end date, and 2) interim evidence that covers the period between the report end date (2026-10-31) and today so we can close the gap in our risk register.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a dated bridge letter to cover the post-report window and a small evidence bundle (control owner attestations, control-run screenshots, or logs) to support a brief attestation? Our deadline to present to the review board is next Friday (2027-04-16).

Appreciate any detail on timing and what you can share under NDA.

Best,
Eva
Security Program Lead
HelioTech

[Attachment: procurement-checklist-HelioTech.xlsx (XLSX) referenced]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Eva Guzman <eva.guzman@heliotech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T19:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Bridge letter / interim evidence request for SOC 2 coverage

Eva — thanks for the note and context. Short answer: yes, we can provide a SOC 2 bridge letter that documents the audit period and any material changes. We can also assemble a compact evidence bundle for the post-report interval to support your procurement review.

Next steps I propose:
- Kimberly will own the bridge-letter draft and sign-off flow.
- Irene will compile a targeted evidence package (control attestations, recent log excerpts, and a controls matrix snapshot).
- I will send a proposed delivery timeline and a redlined bridge-letter draft by EOD tomorrow so you have something to review before your board.

A couple quick Qs to scope the bundle:
1) For evidence granularity: Do you need system-level logs for the entire interval or just attestations + screenshots for key controls (access provisioning, change management, incident response)?
2) Can you confirm whether HelioTech will accept redacted logs or require original extracts?

We aim to get the draft bridge letter and a preliminary evidence ZIP (attachments referenced) to you no later than 2027-04-09. If HelioTech needs a DocuSign workflow for signature, we can route that once the letter is finalized.

Thanks — Marcus
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stub: bridge_letter_draft.docx]

From: Eva Guzman <eva.guzman@heliotech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: security@heliotech.com
Date: 2027-04-08T15:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Bridge letter / interim evidence request for SOC 2 coverage

Marcus — thanks, that sounds great. To clarify on the two items:
- Evidence scope: Our reviewers will accept control-owner attestations plus screenshots and limited log extracts for critical controls (auth/authn events, privileged access changes, and backup verification). Full raw logs are not required; redacted extracts are fine.
- Acceptance: we will accept a signed PDF bridge letter; DocuSign is optional.

One ask on timing: if you can get the draft and the evidence bundle to us by COB Friday (2027-04-09) that will let us include it in the board packet.

Also, if Kimberly needs a template or wording that matches our procurement questionnaire, I attached our short checklist in the first email — happy to align.

Best,
Eva

Hi Eva — attaching the requested artifacts and a draft bridge letter for HelioTech review. Per Marcus's note, we've scoped the evidence bundle to attestation statements from control owners plus redacted log excerpts for the critical controls you listed. Links and attachments below.

Summary of deliverables included:
- Bridge letter (draft) that confirms Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report effective period (2026-01-01 to 2026-10-31) and states there have been no material control changes affecting the trust services criteria since report issuance. We note the date range covered by the letter and include authority statements.
- Evidence bundle: control-owner attestations (change mgmt, provisioning, incident response), redacted authn/privileged-access log extracts (sampled), and a controls matrix snapshot (kpi-controls-matrix.xlsx).
- A short readme describing redaction approach and contact points for further evidence requests.

Attachments: [Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026_report.pdf (PDF)], [bridge_letter_draft.docx (DOCX)], [kpi-controls-matrix.xlsx (XLSX)].

If you are good with the wording in the draft, we can convert to a signed PDF and send via DocuSign if you prefer to capture a signature. Let me know if any language needs tightening for procurement.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
